commit_message: Require credential secrecy for ADR 0153 confinement
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0153 agent process confinement
pr_body:
## Summary

- integrate ADR 0153 on the current ADR0147/ADR0149 AI Studio and Agent Host baseline
- add a truthful provider-neutral confinement request/profile contract at the existing external-process boundary
- keep the generic external runtime explicitly application-policy-only and fail closed when provider/OS confinement is required
- require an enforced credential-secrecy guarantee before any provider/OS profile can satisfy strict confinement
- keep provider/MCP credentials and inherited credential-bearing environment out of a sandboxed child before a provider may claim that guarantee
- keep ExternalAssetAcquisition governed through GameEngine/MCP while only explicit NetworkAccess widens ambient child-process network policy
- expose the external-process requirement and actual confinement status in both embedded and detached AI Studio presentations
- add fail-closed, loopback, truthfulness, persistence, credential-secrecy, and cleanup coverage and accept ADR 0153

## Validation

Run GameEngine Windows Validation and Editor Visual Validation because the AI Studio security/confinement status UI changes.
